en.name: Read access to pod's service account token
en.description: Accessing the pod service account token gives an attacker the option to use the server API
en.issueDetail: Every Pod in Kubernetes is associated with a Service Account which by default has access to the Kubernetes API. This access is made available to Pods by an auto-generated token that is made available to the Pod by Kubernetes. An attacker with access to a Pod can read the token and access the Kubernetes API.
en.remediation: It is recommended to explicitly specify a Service Account for all of your workloads (serviceAccountName in Pod.Spec), and manage their permissions according to the least privilege principle.

zh.name: 读取pod service账户token
zh.description: 访问容器service账户给攻击者提供了使用server api的可能
zh.issueDetail: Kubernetes中的每个Pod都与一个服务帐户相关联，默认情况下，该帐户可以访问Kubernetes API。通过Kubernetes向Pod提供的自动生成令牌，Pod可以访问此访问。具有Pod访问权限的攻击者可以读取令牌并访问Kubernetes API。
zh.remediation: 建议为所有工作负载明确指定一个service account（Pod.Spec中的serviceAccountName），并根据最小特权原则管理其权限。

en.name: K8s Version Disclosure
en.description: The kubernetes version could be obtained from the {} endpoint
en.issueDetail:
The fact that your infrastructure is using Kubernetes, and the specific version of Kubernetes used is publicly available, and could be used by an attacker to target your environment with known vulnerabilities in the specific version of Kubernetes you are using.
This information could have been obtained from the Kubernetes API /version endpoint, or from the Kubelet’s /metrics debug endpoint.
en.remediation: Disable --enable-debugging-handlers kubelet flag.

zh.name: K8s版本泄漏
zh.description: The kubernetes version could be obtained from the {} endpoint
zh.issueDetail: 您的基础设施正在使用Kubernetes，并且所使用的Kubernetes的特定版本是公开的，攻击者可能会利用您使用的Kubernetes的特定版本中存在的已知漏洞。此信息可能是从Kubernetes API/版本终结点获得的，或者从Kubelet的/metrics调试端点。
zh.remediation: 禁用 --enable-debugging-handlers kubelet 标志.

en.name: Access to pod's secrets
en.description: Accessing the pod's secrets within a compromised pod might disclose valuable data to a potential attacker

zh.name: 访问pod的secrets
zh.description: 访问风险pod中的pod secrets可能会向潜在攻击者泄露有价值的数据

en.name: Etcd Remote Write Access Event
en.description: Remote write access might grant an attacker full control over the kubernetes cluster
en.issueDetail: Etcd (Kubernetes' Database) is writable without authentication. This gives full control of your Kubernetes cluster to an attacker with access to etcd.
en.remediation: Ensure your etcd is accepting connections only from the Kubernetes API, using the --trusted-ca-file etcd flag. This is usually done by the installer, or cloud platform.

zh.name: Etcd远程写事件
zh.description: 远程写访问可能会授予攻击者对kubernetes群集的完全控制权
zh.issueDetail: Etcd（Kubernetes的数据库）无需身份验证即可写入。这使攻击者能够完全控制Kubernetes群集，从而访问etcd。
zh.remediation: 使用--trusted-ca-file etcd标志，确保您的etcd仅接受来自Kubernetes API的连接。这通常由安装程序或云平台完成。

en.name: Etcd Remote Read Access Event
en.description: Remote read access might expose to an attacker cluster's possible exploits, secrets and more.
en.issueDetail: Etcd (Kubernetes' Database) is accessible without authentication. This exposes the entire state of your Kubernetes cluster to the reader.
en.remediation: Ensure your etcd is accepting connections only from the Kubernetes API, using the --trusted-ca-file etcd flag. This is usually done by the installer, or cloud platform.

zh.name: Etcd远程写事件
zh.description: 远程读取访问可能会暴露给攻击者群集的可能漏洞、机密等。
zh.issueDetail: Etcd（Kubernetes数据库）无需身份验证即可访问。这将向读取者公开Kubernetes集群的整个状态。
zh.remediation: 使用--trusted-ca-file etcd标志，确保您的etcd仅接受来自Kubernetes API的连接。这通常由安装程序或云平台完成。

en.name: Etcd Remote version disclosure
en.description: Remote version disclosure might give an attacker a valuable data to attack a cluster

zh.name: Etcd远程版本泄漏
zh.description: 远程版本泄露可能会给攻击者提供有价值的数据来攻击群集

en.name: Etcd is accessible using insecure connection (HTTP)
en.description: Etcd is accessible using HTTP (without authorization and authentication),it would allow a potential attacker to gain access to the etcd
en.issueDetail: The etcd server (Kubernetes database) port is accessible over plain HTTP, and therefore unencrypted and potentially insecured.
en.remediation: Ensure your setup is exposing etcd only on an HTTPS port by using the etcd flags --key-file and --cert-file.

zh.name: Etcd可以通过不安全的方式连接(HTTP)
zh.description: 可以使用HTTP访问Etcd（无需授权和身份验证），这将允许潜在攻击者访问Etcd
zh.issueDetail: etcd服务器（Kubernetes数据库）端口可通过普通HTTP访问，因此未加密且可能不安全。
zh.remediation: 通过使用etcd标志--key-file和--cert-file，确保安装程序仅在HTTPS端口上公开etcd。

en.name: Anonymous Authentication
en.description: The kubelet is misconfigured, potentially allowing secure access to all requests on the kubelet, without the need to authenticate
en.issueDetail: The kubelet is configured to allow anonymous (unauthenticated) requests to it’s HTTP api. This may expose certein information, and capabilities to an attacker with access to the kubelet API.
en.remediation: Ensure kubelet is protected using --anonymous-auth=false kubelet flag. Allow only legitimate users using --client-ca-file or --authentication-token-webhook kubelet flags. This is usually done by the installer or cloud protitleer.

zh.name: 匿名授权

zh.remediation: 确保使用--anonymous auth=false kubelet标志保护kubelet。仅允许合法用户使用--client-ca-file或--authentication-token-webhook kubelet标志。这通常由安装程序或云protitleer完成。

en.name: Exposed Existing Privileged Container(s) Via Secure Kubelet Port
en.description: A malicious actor, that has confirmed anonymous access to the API via the kubelet's secure port, can leverage the existing privileged containers identified to damage the host and potentially the whole cluster
en.issueDetail: The kubelet is configured to allow anonymous (unauthenticated) requests to its HTTPs API. This may expose certain information and capabilities to an attacker with access to the kubelet API.
en.remediation: A privileged container is given access to all devices on the host and can work at the kernel level. It is declared using the Pod.spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged attribute. This may be useful for infrastructure containers that perform setup work on the host, but is a dangerous attack vector.

zh.name: 通过安全Kubelet端口公开现有特权容器
zh.description: 已确认通过kubelet的安全端口匿名访问API的恶意参与者可以利用已识别的现有特权容器损坏主机，并可能损坏整个集群
zh.issueDetail: kubelet被配置为允许匿名（未经验证）请求其HTTPs API。这可能会将某些信息和功能暴露给能够访问kubelet API的攻击者。
zh.remediation: 特权容器可以访问主机上的所有设备，并且可以在内核级别工作。它是使用Pod.spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged属性声明的。这对于在主机上执行安装工作的基础设施容器可能是有用的，但却是危险的攻击向量。

en.name: Privileged Container
en.description: A Privileged container exist on a node could expose the node/cluster to unwanted root operations

zh.name: 特权容器
zh.description: 节点上存在特权容器可能会使节点/群集发生不可预知的root操作

en.name: Exposed System Logs
en.description: System logs are exposed from the /logs endpoint on the kubelet
en.issueDetail: The kubelet is leaking system logs via the /logs endpoint. This endpoint is exposed as part of the kubelet’s debug handlers.
en.remediation: Disable --enable-debugging-handlers kubelet flag.

zh.name: 系统日志暴露
zh.description: 系统日志从kubelet上的/logs端点公开
zh.issueDetail: kubelet正在通过/logs端点泄漏系统日志。该端点作为kubelet调试处理程序的一部分公开。
zh.remediation: 禁用--enable-debugging-handlers kubelet 标志.

en.name: Exposed Kubelet Cmdline
en.description: Commandline flags that were passed to the kubelet can be obtained from the pprof endpoints
en.issueDetail: When the Kubelet is run in debug mode, a Pod running in the cluster is able to access the Kubelet’s debug/pprof/cmdline endpoint and examine how the kubelet was executed on the node, specifically the command line flags that were used, which tells the attacker about what capabilities the kubelet has which might be exploited.
en.remediation: Disable --enable-debugging-handlers kubelet flag.

zh.name: 暴露Kubelet命令行
zh.description: 可以从pprof端点获取传递给kubelet的命令行标志
zh.issueDetail: 当Kubelet在调试模式下运行时，群集中运行的Pod能够访问Kubelet的debug/pprof/cmdline端点，并检查Kubelet是如何在节点上执行的，特别是所使用的命令行标志，这会告诉攻击者Kubelet具有哪些可能被利用的功能。
zh.remediation: 禁用 --enable-debugging-handlers kubelet标志.

en.name: Azure SPN Exposure
en.description: The SPN is exposed, potentially allowing an attacker to gain access to the Azure subscription
en.issueDetail: Kubernetes has native integration with Microsoft Azure, for that a Kubernetes installation on Azure will require API access to manage the cluster’s resources in Azure (for example, to create a cloud load balancer). Some installations of Kubernetes on Azure rely on a shared file on the node that contains credentials to the Azure API under /etc/kubernetes/azure.json. A Pod with access to this file may become a gateway for an attacker to control your Azure environment.
en.remediation: The better solution would be to use Azure Managed Identities instead of a static SPN. However this functionality is not mature yet, and is currently available in alpha stage only for aks-engine (non-managed Kubernetes).

zh.name: Azure SPN 暴露
zh.description: SPN已暴露，可能允许攻击者访问Azure订阅
zh.issueDetail: Kubernetes与Microsoft Azure进行了本机集成，因为在Azure上安装Kubernetes需要API访问才能管理Azure中的群集资源（例如，创建云负载平衡器）。Azure上的某些Kubernetes安装依赖于节点上的共享文件，该文件包含/etc/Kubernetes/Azure.json下Azure API的凭据。访问此文件的Pod可能成为攻击者控制Azure环境的网关。
zh.remediation: 更好的解决方案是使用Azure托管标识，而不是静态SPN。但是，该功能尚未成熟，目前仅在alpha阶段可用于aks引擎（非托管Kubernetes）。

en.name: Possible Arp Spoof
en.description: A malicious pod running on the cluster could potentially run an ARP Spoof attack and perform a MITM between pods on the node.
en.issueDetail: When using a basic (but common) container networking in the cluster, containers on the same host are bridged togeather to form a virtual layer 2 network. This setup, which is also common for Kubernetes installations. What’s also common in Kubernetes installations, is that the NET_RAW capability is granted to Pods, allowing them low level access to network interactions. By pairing these two issues together, a malicious Pod running on the cluster could abusing the ARP protocol (used to discover MAC address by IP) in order to spoof the IP address of another pod on same node, thus making other pods on the node talk to the attacker’s Pod instead of the legitimate Pod.
en.remediation: Consider dropping the NET_RAW capability from your pods using Pod.spec.securityContext.capabilities

zh.name: 可能的ARP欺骗
zh.description: 群集上运行的恶意pod可能会运行ARP欺骗攻击，并在节点上的pod之间执行MITM。
zh.issueDetail: 在群集中使用基本（但通用）容器网络时，同一主机上的容器将桥接在一起以形成虚拟的第2层网络。此设置也适用于Kubernetes安装。Kubernetes安装中的另一个共同点是，将NET_RAW功能授予POD，允许它们对网络交互进行低级访问。通过将这两个问题配对在一起，集群上运行的恶意Pod可能会滥用ARP协议（用于通过IP发现MAC地址），以欺骗同一节点上另一个Pod的IP地址，从而使该节点上的其他Pod与攻击者的Pod而不是合法Pod对话。
zh.remediation: 考虑使用PODSPEC.SurvivCutExt.能力从POD中删除NETSRAW原始能力。

en.name: Certificate Includes Email Address
en.description: The Kubernetes API Server advertises a public certificate for TLS.This certificate includes an email address, that may provide additional information for an attacker on your organization, or be abused for further email based attacks.
en.issueDetail: The Kubernetes API Server advertises a public certificate for TLS. This certificate includes an email address, that may protitlee additional information for an attacker on your organization, or be abused for further email based attacks.
en.remediation: Do not include email address in the Kubernetes API server certificate. (You should continue to use certificates to secure the API Server!)

zh.name: 证书包括电子邮件地址
zh.description: Kubernetes API服务器播发TLS的公共证书。此证书包含一个电子邮件地址，该地址可能为组织上的攻击者提供附加信息，或被滥用以进行进一步的基于电子邮件的攻击。
zh.issueDetail: Kubernetes API服务器播发TLS的公共证书。此证书包含一个电子邮件地址，该地址可能为组织上的攻击者提供附加信息，或被滥用以进行进一步的基于电子邮件的攻击。
zh.remediation: 不要在Kubernetes API服务器证书中包含电子邮件地址。（您应该继续使用证书来保护API服务器！）

en.name: Dashboard Exposed
en.description: All operations on the cluster are exposed
en.issueDetail: An open Kubernetes Dashboard was detected. The Kubernetes Dashboard can be used by an attacker to learn about the cluster and potentially to create new resources.
en.remediation: Do not leave the Dashboard insecured.

zh.name: Dashboard暴露
zh.description: 集群所有操作暴露
zh.issueDetail: 检测到打开的Kubernetes仪表板。攻击者可以使用Kubernetes仪表板了解集群，并可能创建新资源。
zh.remediation: 不要让仪表板处于不安全状态。

en.name: Possible DNS Spoof
en.description: A malicious pod running on the cluster could potentially run a DNS Spoof attack and perform a MITM attack on applications running in the cluster.
en.issueDetail: Your Kubernetes DNS setup is vulnerable to spoofing attacks which impersonate your DNS for malicious purposes.In this case the exploited vulnerability was ARP spoofing, but other methods could be used as well.
en.remediation: Consider using DNS over TLS. CoreDNS (the common DNS server for Kubernetes) supports this out of the box, but your client applications might not.

zh.name: 可能的饿DNS欺骗
zh.description: 群集上运行的恶意pod可能会运行DNS欺骗攻击，并对群集中运行的应用程序执行MITM攻击。
zh.issueDetail: 您的Kubernetes DNS设置容易受到出于恶意目的模拟您的DNS的欺骗攻击。在这种情况下，被利用的漏洞是ARP欺骗，但也可以使用其他方法。
zh.remediation: 考虑在TLS上使用DNS。CoreDNS（Kubernetes的通用DNS服务器）支持这种开箱即用的方式，但您的客户端应用程序可能不支持。

en.name: Pod With Mount To /var/log
en.description: A pod can create symlinks in the /var/log directory on the host, which can lead to a root directory traveral
en.issueDetail: Kubernetes uses /var/log/pods on nodes to store Pods log files. When running kubectl logs the kubelet is fetching the pod logs from that directory. If a container has write access to /var/log it can create arbitrary files, or symlink to other files on the host. Those would be read by the kubelet when a user executes kubectl logs.
en.remediation:
Consider disallowing running as root:
Using Kubernetes Pod Security Policies with MustRunAsNonRoot policy. users can use a Runtime Policy with Volume Blacklist.

zh.name: Pod挂载了/var/log
zh.description: pod可以在主机上的/var/log目录中创建符号链接，这可以导致根目录遍历
zh.issueDetail: Kubernetes在节点上使用/var/log/pods来存储pods日志文件。运行kubectl日志时，kubelet正在从该目录获取pod日志。如果容器对/var/log具有写访问权，则它可以创建任意文件，或将其符号链接到主机上的其他文件。当用户执行kubectl日志时，kubelet将读取这些日志。
zh.remediation: 考虑禁止以root权限运行：使用Kubnet pod的安全策略MustRunAsNonRoot。用户可以使用带有黑名单的运行时策略。

en.name: Root Traversal Read On The Kubelet
en.description: An attacker can run commands on pods with mount to /var/log, and traverse read all files on the host filesystem

zh.name: Kubelet上的root遍历
zh.description: 攻击者可以使用mount to /var/log在POD上运行命令，并遍历主机文件系统上的所有文件

en.name: Proxy Exposed
en.description: All operations on the cluster are exposed
en.issueDetail: An open kubectl proxy was detected. kubectl proxy is a convenient tool to connect from a local machine into an application running in Kubernetes or to the Kubernetes API. This is common practice to browse for example the Kubernetes dashboard. Leaving an open proxy can be exploited by an attacker to gain access into your entire cluster.
en.remediation: Expose your applications in a permanent, legitimate way, such as via Ingress.

zh.name: 代理暴露
zh.description: 集群所有操作暴露
zh.issueDetail: 检测到打开的kubectl代理。kubectl proxy是一个方便的工具，可以从本地机器连接到运行在Kubernetes中的应用程序或Kubernetes API。例如，浏览Kubernetes仪表板是常见的做法。攻击者可以利用离开打开的代理来访问整个集群。
zh.remediation: 以永久、合法的方式公开应用程序，例如通过ingress。

en.name: AWS Metadata Exposure
en.description: Access to the AWS Metadata API exposes information about the machines associated with the cluster
en.issueDetail: AWS EC2 protitlees an internal HTTP endpoint that exposes information from the cloud platform to workloads running in an instance. The endpoint is accessible to every workload running in the instance. An attacker that is able to execute a pod in the cluster may be able to query the metadata service and discover additional information about the environment.
en.remediation: Limit access to the instance metadata service. Consider using a local firewall such as iptables to disable access from some or all processes/users to the instance metadata service.Disable the metadata service (via instance metadata options or IAM), or at a minimum enforce the use IMDSv2 on an instance to require token-based access to the service.Modify the HTTP PUT response hop limit on the instance to 1. This will only allow access to the service from the instance itself rather than from within a pod..

zh.name: AWS元数据泄漏
zh.description: 对AWS元数据API的访问泄露了了与群集关联的计算机的信息
zh.issueDetail: AWS EC2提供了一个内部HTTP端点，该端点将来自云平台的信息公开给实例中运行的工作负载。实例中运行的每个工作负载都可以访问端点。能够在群集中执行pod的攻击者可能能够查询元数据服务并发现有关环境的其他信息。
zh.remediation: 限制对实例元数据服务的访问，考虑使用本地防火墙（例如IPTABLE）禁用某些或所有进程/用户对实例元数据服务的访问。禁用元数据服务（通过实例元数据选项或IAM），或者至少在实例上强制使用IMDSv2以要求基于令牌的服务访问。将实例上的HTTP PUT响应跃点限制修改为1，这将只允许从实例本身而不是从pod内访问服务。

en.name: Azure Metadata Exposure
en.description: Access to the Azure Metadata API exposes information about the machines associated with the cluster
en.issueDetail: Microsoft Azure protitlees an internal HTTP endpoint that exposes information from the cloud platform to workloads running in a VM. The endpoint is accessible to every workload running in the VM. An attacker that is able to execute a pod in the cluster may be able to query the metadata service and discover additional information about the environment.
en.remediation: Starting in the 2020.10.15 Azure VHD Release, AKS restricts the pod CIDR access to that internal HTTP endpoint.

zh.name: Azure元数据泄漏
zh.description: 对Azure元数据API的访问泄露了了与群集关联的计算机的信息
zh.issueDetail: Microsoft Azure Protitle提供了一个内部HTTP端点，该端点将来自云平台的信息公开给运行在VM中的工作负载。VM中运行的每个工作负载都可以访问端点。能够在群集中执行pod的攻击者可能能够查询元数据服务并发现有关环境的其他信息。
zh.remediation: 从2020.10.15 Azure VHD版本开始，AKS限制pod CIDR对该内部HTTP端点的访问。
